notes.title: Demo Release and R18 Prologue Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

You can now play Bloodcrave's demo on Steam. It contains the first two hours of the game. On top of that, if you prefer more spicy content, then you will be able to test the R18 version of the game in two weeks! 

You can wishlist it now here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3051720/Bloodcrave_R18_Prologue/

Don't forget to let us know what you think about Bloodcrave!
